raw.title: IP Engineer
raw.company: CÔNG TY TNHH CÔNG NGHỆ HUAWEI VIỆT NAM
description_list: Design, implement Huawei enterprise network solutions (Backbone, Metro，WAN, SRV6，DCN).
Provide technical support for post-sales activities, including Design, deployment and migration.
Perform installation, configuration, commissioning, and troubleshooting of Huawei enterprise products (Router, Switches, iMaster NCE, etc.).
Proficient in core IP routing protocols, including OSPF, IS-IS, and BGP.Capable of solution design, deployment, and service migration based on the aforementioned IP protocols.
Support enterprise customers in incident response, problem resolution, and performance tuning.
Collaborate with R&D and GTAC teams for complex issue escalation and product improvements.
Conduct training, workshops, and knowledge transfer sessions for customers and partners.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including design guides, operation manuals, and change records.
requirements_list: Education Background Requirements: Bachelor or higher, major: Telecommunications technology, or related fields.
3–5 years of experience in enterprise networking or security solutions.
Solid knowledge of routing, switching, wireless, and security technologies.
Familiar with network automation and SDN platforms (Huawei iMaster NCE is a plus).
Understanding of enterprise cloud networking and security best practices.
Ability to perform complex troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
Able to communicate effectively in English both speaking and writing.
Family with Microsoft office, Excel, Power point.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing environments and manage parallel time-critical tasks.
Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
Huawei online and offline aboard training.
Participating in full insurance benefits (health insurance, social insurance, unemployment insurance), the company supports 24/24 accident insurance and health care insurance for employees.
Professional working environment, multinational company, good career development opportunities. Cultural and sports activities, taking care of employees' health and life are organized periodically...
